tex_content.label: Ccomponent
tex_content.html:
A compact connected Riemannian $3$-manifold $(M,g)$ is a $C$-component if:

  1. $M$ is diffeomorphic to $S^3$ or $\Ar P^3$;

  2. $M$ has positive sectional curvature;

  3. \[ C^{-1}<\frac{\inf _PK(P)}{\sup _MR}; \]

  4. \[ C^{-1}\sup _MR^{-1/2}<\diam M<C\inf _MR^{-1/2}. \]

Definition
[$\epsilon $-round component]
